- **[skill-content-audit](system/skill-content-audit/)** — Content audit: verify scripts, paths, cross-refs.
- **[smart-cache](system/smart-cache/)** — Use for cache scan, cleanup, skill archiving, and warm-cache reports.
- **[smart-cron-scheduler](system/smart-cron-scheduler/)** — Use to optimize cron schedules or run Smart Cron Scheduler.
- **[smart-session-saver](system/smart-session-saver/)** — Use for session archiving, search, restore, and stats.
- **[system-snapshot](system/system-snapshot/)** — Use for full system-state snapshot + diff + HTTP:8898.
- **[task-queue](system/task-queue/)** — Use for persistent task-queue with priorities + daemon.
- **[web-platform-servers](system/web-platform-servers/)** — Use for OpenAmer HTTP server architecture and health-checks.
- **[webhook-engine](system/webhook-engine/)** — Use for Webhook Engine on port 8900: rules, actions, API.
- **[windows-path-resolution](system/windows-path-resolution/)** — MSYS→Win path: convert + HOME resolve for git-bash Python.
- **[windows-tool-env](system/windows-tool-env/)** — Use when terminal/write_file fail on Windows due to bash/WSL
